C_COD_CREDITED_DEFECTS.rationale: The candidate identifies both unprompted defects: an empty coupon list causing an IndexError on index 0, and an unmapped account tier raising a KeyError on DISCOUNT_BY_TIER, explicitly detailing the inputs that trigger each.

C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The candidate identifies floating-point arithmetic from division as an additional defect and explains why it matters: rounding dust can mischarge customers and prevent finance from reconciling accounts.

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The candidate clearly exceeds Level 3 by explaining who loses (stating the merchant loses most of the sale and eats the loss from undercharging and zero/negative balances). However, it falls short of Level 5 because it does not explicitly point out that settling at zero fails silently while negative balances cause payment processing failures.
